reviews.title: Could be 5 stars... Hire new software developers
reviews.text:
Pos: The cost is not cheap, but it gives me access to 85% of the shows and sports I want, and unlimited simultaneous recording (I have to use Prime for TNF and such).

Huge Cons: The software, especially the mobile app:

• Buffering or freezing during live sports or recordings
•  Unreliable fast-forward, rewind, and skip (sometimes jumping to the wrong place, live, the end, or an earlier point)
•  Playback that stutters, skips, or requires restarting the app
•  worse on mobile (especially cellular) or when watching delayed/live content and even on completed recordings

And I have switched to other apps on the same device with same coverage with no problem. It's all about how the software handles packeting and buffering, and horrible ffwd and play-pause mechanics and buffering / finding it's place (and yes, I know and try all the tricks - force close, restart phone, reset wifi, update app... )

reviews.title: Falsely Advertised Free Trial
reviews.text: I signed up for their supposed 7 day free trial to keep up with sports while on vacation. I didn’t bother to check my email for the exact subscription renewal date because I knew I’d be back before 7 days and have time to cancel it. I’m in PST, but even adjusting for Fubo’s EST billing, trial started Saturday at 2 PM and renewed on Friday (the 7th day) at 2 AM. By no definition is that a 7 day trial. Note that 2 AM EST on Friday is 11 PM PST on Thursday, which is why I thought I had an extra day, but even ignoring PST entirely, that’s a 6.5 day trial. I happened to be up late and catch the renewal email so I logged in, and they actually had the nerve provide an automated bot option to cancel and process the refund. In other words, they know they’re illegally lying and cheating so they just made it automated to get your money back in the hopes that people will miss it and accept getting cheated. What a shady way to do business. I appreciate that getting a refund was easy, but when you advertise a 7 day trial, you can’t arbitrarily make it 6.5 days and renew early on the 7th day.

reviews.title: !!!PLEASE READ!!! THEY CHARGED MY CARD OVER 12X
reviews.text: Tried the free trial and canceled it a day before it ended, shopping around to find the best deal for what I’m looking for. Went through the cancellation process and called it a day. Woke up to multiple messages from my card “suspicious activity” I saw them charge me for a monthly. I was like no way, I canceled it. It was also supposed to be rated cheaper for a month; they derigged on that too. They continued to charge my card 12 times in less than 7 days. Tried to talk to support, all I got was AI and no human; wouldn’t even give me an option to talk to a human. They sent a email saying 24 hours to pay and charged my card 2 more times. Got the notice of you no longer have access to Fubo. Then charged my card again. So I no longer have access to an app I could have potentially circled around back to because I’m trying to shop around & see what would be worth the money. I guess they didn’t like that I canceled after a free trial? Even my bank was like whoa this is beyond obsessive. Their support was awful and pushed the blame to the user when I have proof of cancellation. Support refused to help one bit. This is a warning to people that want to try a free trial or looking to cancel the service. It’s going to be a mess. Get ahold of your bank a head of time, get things in order if you need a new card. Fubo blames you and tells you to tell your bank to block the charges. All your other monthly payments that you have on your card; write them all down, so when your new card comes
